Image 2 controls mascot anatomy and identity only; its bare scalp or lack of eyebrows must not erase source-visible hair. The rounded chin meets a VERY SHORT BROAD neck transition. Refit the existing neckline and lapels around the compact head while preserving their open/closed style; do not fill an open V with a long narrow yellow funnel.
Use case: compositing. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body, featuring green-ringed black eyes and a source-matching mouth. Preserve the actual bareheaded short silver/grey swept-back side-parted hair with a receding forehead and real grey eyebrow hair. Maintain the actual small silver/grey upper-lip moustache, smooth clean chin, and serious closed mouth. Do not add spectacles, caps, chin beards, or invented teeth. Retain the actual dark navy/black open civilian suit with subtle original cloth texture, pale grey/white shirt collar, and the actual dark blue/navy short bow tie with two short lateral fabric wings and faint pale pattern. The pale vertical area below the bow is the shirt front, not a long tie; do not replace the blue bow with red or a long necktie. Preserve the exact primary near-frontal mild angle/roll and tight bust crop, opaque grey photographic backing/light, full tilted dark frame, and cream lower-right note overlap. Ensure a clearly rounded short U-shaped lower yellow head that immediately meets the raised/broadened existing neckline, with a very short broad neck transition and minimal throat exposure. No separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open garment and fastening with coherent front/rear collar overlap and contact shadow. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque grey backing, and attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. No invented insignia, text, or accessories. Fine primary details that are indistinct must stay understated.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED short SILVER/GREY swept-back side-parted hair with receding forehead and real GREY eyebrow HAIR. Actual small SILVER/GREY upper-lip MOUSTACHE, smooth clean chin and serious CLOSED mouth, no spectacles/cap/chin beard or invented teeth. Actual DARK NAVY/BLACK OPEN civilian suit with subtle original cloth texture, PALE GREY/WHITE shirt collar and actual DARK BLUE/NAVY BOW TIE with two short lateral fabric wings and faint pale pattern. Pale vertical area below bow is shirt front, NOT a pale long tie; do not replace actual BLUE BOW with RED or long necktie. Preserve exact primary near-frontal mild angle/roll/tight bust crop, OPAQUE GREY photographic backing/light, full tilted dark frame and cream lower-right note overlap. No hidden lapel pins, military regalia or new accessories; fine bow/shirt markings stay understated. One compact near-round yellow head with rounded SHORT U chin, raised/broadened actual shirt neckline and coherent bow/collar contact, minimal very short broad neck transition, no yellow shaft/long V. Preserve actual BLUE/NAVY SHORT BOW TIE with lateral wings and subtle pale pattern, PALE SHIRT FRONT below, no RED or pale long necktie. Bare silver swept receding hair/real grey brows, small SILVER moustache and clean chin remain. OPEN DARK civilian suit, rounded SHORT U chin and very short broad transition touching raised broadened shirt/bow neckline, no shaft/long yellow V, cap or hidden lapel pin. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only. All actual solid surfaces and backing opaque; genuine alpha only outside complete card.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
